title: V-8 ENG. 350 CU. IN. SPEC. HI PERF.- NON-ILLUSTRATED PARTS
summary: RPO LT1 (350 cu in special high-performance V-8 / solid-lifter small block): list of LT1-related components not drawn in this option section (underbody upholstery items, rear hubs, engine, crankcase ventilation, fan & drive, air cleaner, throttle control, A/C compressor, generator, distributor, fuel tank, fuel lines, exhaust, instruments). Most assemble the same as production; the differential and axle shafts assemble as RPO LS5, the carburetor as RPO LJ1-LJ2. Part numbers are in the parts list or bill of material.
notes: NOTE: The following components are not illustrated in this R.P.O. See Parts List or Bill of Materials for part numbers.
◑ Assemble same as production. See Parts List or Bill of Material for part numbers.
notes_internal: Title block UPC box prints 'LT-1'; group normalised to RPO code LT1 (neighbouring sheets print 'LT1').
A06 is printed in the UPC column as 'UPC A06' (no UPC number); written as-is.
11D HOOD line reads 'Assembles same as RPO' with no RPO code printed.
Circled revision 1 beside 8C line. No parts/fastening: list sheet only. Page stamped K370. C/O A2.
